notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has a counter on it.
description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it this turn.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a creature you control, creating a Treasure artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Treasure and Squirrel tokens, you may activate Fain's other abilities.
